punchline: An average life is about four thousand weeks, and the inbox never empties.
thirty_sec: Journalist Oliver Burkeman wrote about productivity for years, yet answering email faster only brought more email, and clearing a list only brought a new one. Then he worked out that an average life is about four thousand weeks. He dropped the dream of getting on top of everything, made room for a few things that matter, and deliberately neglected the rest.
